title: Ophthalmic Medical Technicians
description: Assist ophthalmologists by performing ophthalmic clinical functions. May administer eye exams, administer eye medications, and instruct the patient in care and use of corrective lenses.

tasks.text: Take and document patients' medical histories.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient history requires live elicitation and judgment

dwas.name: Collect medical information from patients, family members, or other medical professionals.

tasks.text: Conduct tonometry or tonography tests to measure intraocular pressure.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Vision tests require hands-on patient examination

tasks.text: Operate ophthalmic equipment, such as autorefractors, phoropters, tomographs, or retinoscopes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Vision tests require hands-on patient examination

emerging.task: Perform examinations using ophthalmic equipment, such as autorefractors, phoropters, tomographs, or retinoscopes.
emerging.original_task: Operate ophthalmic equipment, such as autorefractors, phoropters, tomographs, or retinoscopes.

tasks.text: Take anatomical or functional ocular measurements of the eye or surrounding tissue, such as axial length measurements.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Measuring physiological attributes needs hands-on devices

dwas.name: Measure the physical or physiological attributes of patients.

tasks.text: Measure visual acuity, including near, distance, pinhole, or dynamic visual acuity, using appropriate tests.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Vision tests require hands-on patient examination

tasks.text: Measure and record lens power, using lensometers.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient history requires live elicitation and judgment

dwas.name: Operate diagnostic or therapeutic medical instruments or equipment.

tasks.text: Administer topical ophthalmic or oral medications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Administering medications is hands-on clinical action

tasks.text: Conduct visual field tests to measure field of vision.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Vision tests require hands-on patient examination

tasks.text: Assist physicians in performing ophthalmic procedures, including surgery.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Sterile hands-on surgical assistance

tasks.text: Measure corneal curvature with keratometers or ophthalmometers to aid in the diagnosis of conditions, such as astigmatism.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Measuring physiological attributes needs hands-on devices

dwas.name: Measure the physical or physiological attributes of patients.

tasks.text: Conduct ocular motility tests to measure function of eye muscles.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Vision tests require hands-on patient examination

tasks.text: Clean or sterilize ophthalmic or surgical instruments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Loading and operating sterilizing equipment by hand

tasks.text: Maintain ophthalmic instruments or equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on medical instrument maintenance

tasks.text: Instruct patients in the care and use of contact lenses.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient assistive-equipment instruction is hands-on care

dwas.name: Instruct patients in the use of assistive equipment.

tasks.text: Assess refractive conditions of eyes, using retinoscopes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Diagnostic instruments applied to patients by hand

dwas.name: Operate diagnostic or therapeutic medical instruments or equipment.

tasks.text: Call patients to inquire about their post-operative status or recovery.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Post-surgical monitoring is hands-on clinical observation

dwas.name: Monitor patients following surgeries or other treatments.

tasks.text: Assist patients to insert or remove contact lenses.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient assistive-equipment instruction is hands-on care

dwas.name: Instruct patients in the use of assistive equipment.

tasks.text: Conduct binocular disparity tests to assess depth perception.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Vision tests require hands-on patient examination

tasks.text: Adjust or make minor repairs to spectacles or eyeglasses.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Fitting eyewear requires hands-on patient measurement

dwas.name: Fit eyeglasses, contact lenses, or other vision aids.

tasks.text: Assist patients to select eyewear.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Assistive device recommendations need client-specific assessment

dwas.name: Recommend types of assistive devices.
